source_instruction: i would like a pink hair cutting kit that is easy to use
query: Ugh, I spent my whole walk over here replaying that last cat café visit in my head—there was this chonky tabby that kept stealing matcha mochi bits off my plate, the barista gave me a free lavender latte ‘cause I laughed so hard I spilled my first one, I even stopped to pet a golden retriever puppy tied up outside the shop that kept trying to chew the cuff of my jeans, and I still can’t stop thinking about how I forgot to grab a pack of those sour watermelon gummy candies I love on the way in. Anyway, I’m looking for hair cutting tools that are super easy to use, under $20, and come in that soft rose shade, you know the one?
